A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same VimoRAG research. The complete main texts, equations, tables, figures, and appendices support reliable comparison. Material moved from the appendices into the main text can be matched across versions.

before.justification: v1 reports original motion-generation results on HumanML3D and IDEA400, retrieval evaluations, ablations, sensitivity analyses, and latency measurements.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the benchmark comparisons and supplementary experiments in Appendix A.

M1.justification: The Gemini-MVR dual retrievers and similarity integrator, motion-generation architecture, and two-stage McDPO procedure are unchanged. Expanded figure captions explain existing components without introducing a different method.

E1.justification: Both versions use HumanML3D, zero-shot IDEA400 evaluation, and the same HcVD database and source datasets. No training domain, evaluation task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain identical comparator sets, including the motion-generation baselines, InternVideo and random-retrieval ablations, and MotionGPT-13B latency comparison. Expanded descriptions of existing methods in Section 2 do not introduce evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: The HumanML3D 80/5/15 split, randomly sampled 10% IDEA400 test subset, metrics, model configurations, training budgets, and inference settings remain unchanged. Appendix A retains the same experimental protocols.

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same retriever and McDPO ablations, database-scaling experiments, LoRA and temperature analyses, random-versus-rank-1 retrieval tests, latency analysis, and qualitative examples. Relocated displays do not constitute new analyses.

E5.justification: Section 4.3 specifies ten evaluations and 95% confidence intervals in both versions. The intervals in Tables 1 and 7 are identical; the complete appendix uncertainty table was already present in v1.

E6.justification: All eight tables retain their result entries and numerical values, and the figures retain their findings and examples. For instance, VimoRAG's IDEA400 FID remains 2.388 ± 0.056 and its HumanML3D FID remains 0.131 ± 0.007.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(6), the instruction-tuning objective, and the mathematical definitions of retrieval integration and dual-alignment rewards are unchanged. No new theorem, proof, assumption, or derivation is introduced.

C1.justification: The central framework and performance claims remain unchanged. However, Section 2 newly claims that the authors are the first to identify error propagation in motion-RAG frameworks; v1 only said this issue was not thoroughly investigated in ReMoDiffuse.

C2.justification: The interpretations of retrieval robustness, database scaling, temperature, and latency remain unchanged. The latency limitation, misuse discussion, and future-work qualifications are retained through relocation from Appendices E–G into the main text.

D1.justification: The abstract changes from promising forthcoming GitHub resources to reporting that resources are available through a project website. Actual availability cannot be verified from the PDFs. Implementation, hardware, preprocessing, and hyperparameter disclosures otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 expands its discussion of motion specialists and motion LLMs and makes the distinction from ReMoDiffuse more explicit. It adds Ho et al.'s Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models citation and the error-propagation priority claim; other references are retained.

P1.justification: Related Work is expanded and rewritten. Former Appendices E–F become Section 5, Discussion, and Appendix G is incorporated into Section 6, Conclusion and Future Work. Acknowledgments and author information are updated, while most prose remains unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 2 and 4 receive more informative captions, and existing figures and tables shift within the layout, including Figure 5 moving to the experiment page. All thirteen figures and eight tables are retained without new graphical results.

improvement.justification: The expanded related-work discussion and captions for Figures 2 and 4 clarify the framework and its relationship to prior methods. Moving the existing limitations and impact discussion into the main text makes them more visible. These are limited communication improvements: the method and empirical evidence are unchanged, and the reported resource release cannot be independently established from the PDFs.
